name: Dockerfiles
description: Every Dockerfile in the tree, parsed without a tool: the stages it builds, the image each one starts from and how that image is pinned, the user the image ends as, the ports it exposes, the paths it copies in and the names of the build arguments and environment variables it declares, plus the findings of a hadolint report when the build already left one behind.

dockerfiles.description: Comma separated globs matched against the path and name of every Dockerfile found anywhere in the working directory, to narrow which ones are described. Discovery itself is fixed, so a glob here can only remove files, never add them.

reports.description: Comma separated globs naming the hadolint SARIF reports to read. A report the build produced is read, never rerun, and a file that is not a SARIF document is skipped.

maxFindings.description: Maximum number of lint findings to carry in the facts. `lint.total` still includes findings that are dropped.

facts.dockerfiles: Every Dockerfile that was parsed, in path order. The collector does its own parsing, so these facts are present whether or not a linter ever ran.
facts.dockerfiles[].path: Path of the Dockerfile, relative to the directory the CLI runs in.
facts.dockerfiles[].stages: Every stage the file builds, in the order its `FROM` instructions declare them.
facts.dockerfiles[].stages[].name: Name the stage was given with `AS`, or `null` when it was given none.
facts.dockerfiles[].stages[].image: The `FROM` argument exactly as it is written, so a stage based on `$BASE_IMAGE` or on an earlier stage reads as it does in the file.
facts.dockerfiles[].stages[].registry: Registry host the image names, or `null` when it names none and Docker Hub is implied.
facts.dockerfiles[].stages[].repository: Repository within that registry, without the tag or the digest.
facts.dockerfiles[].stages[].tag: Tag the `FROM` names, or `null` when it names none, which Docker resolves as `latest`.
facts.dockerfiles[].stages[].digest: Digest the `FROM` pins the image to, or `null` when it pins none.
facts.dockerfiles[].stages[].platform: Platform given with `--platform`, or `null` when the stage builds for the host's.
facts.dockerfiles[].user: Argument of the last `USER` instruction, or `null` when the file sets none and the image runs as root.
facts.dockerfiles[].exposedPorts: Every port `EXPOSE` declares, as written, so `8080/tcp` keeps its protocol.
facts.dockerfiles[].healthcheck: Whether the file declares a `HEALTHCHECK`. `HEALTHCHECK NONE` disables one, and reads as `false`.
facts.dockerfiles[].buildArgs: Names of the arguments `ARG` declares. Names only, never the defaults beside them, because a default can be a credential and these facts are evidence.
facts.dockerfiles[].envKeys: Names of the variables `ENV` sets. Names only, never the values beside them, for the same reason.
facts.dockerfiles[].copiedPaths: Every source path `COPY` and `ADD` name, without the destination they are copied to.
facts.dockerfiles[].instructions: How many times each instruction appears, by instruction name.
facts.dockerfiles[].unparsed: Which lines could not be read as an instruction, present only when a line could not be. Line numbers only, never what the line said.
facts.source: `report` when a hadolint report was read, `none` when there was none. The Dockerfile facts above are collected either way.
facts.reason: Why no findings were read, present only when `source` is `none`.
facts.reports: Every hadolint report that was read, in path order.
facts.reports[].path: Path of the report, relative to the directory the CLI runs in.
facts.reports[].modified: When the report was last written, in ISO 8601, so you can spot a stale report.
facts.reports[].format: Format it was read as, always `sarif`.
facts.reports[].producer.name: Linter that wrote it, as the report names itself, or `null` when it names none.
facts.reports[].producer.version: Version of that linter, or `null` when the report carries none.
facts.lint.findings: The findings the reports carried, up to `maxFindings`.
facts.lint.findings[].id: Rule the finding breaks, such as `DL3008`.
facts.lint.findings[].severity: `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `info` or `unknown`, as the report rated it.
facts.lint.findings[].message: What the linter said, truncated to 500 characters.
facts.lint.findings[].path: Dockerfile it was found in, exactly as the report recorded it rather than resolved by this collector, or `null`.
facts.lint.findings[].line: Line it was found on, or `null`.
facts.lint.total: Findings across every report that was read, whole even when findings were dropped.
facts.lint.dropped: Findings left out because `maxFindings` was reached.
